title.zh: 将朗布隆省卡希迪奥坎市镇伦邦小学的名称变更为Damaso Ramilo纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Lumbang Elementary School in the Municipality of Cajidiocan, Province of Romblon, to Damaso Ramilo Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Lumbang Elementary School in the Municipality of Cajidiocan, Province of Romblon, to Damaso Ramilo Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Lumbang tại Thị trấn Cajidiocan, Tỉnh Romblon thành Trường tiểu học Damaso Ramilo Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Lumbang ในเทศบาล Cajidiocan, จังหวัด Romblon เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Damaso Ramilo Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Lumbang di Kotamadya Cajidiocan, Provinsi Romblon menjadi Sekolah Dasar Damaso Ramilo Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Lumbang di Perbandaran Cajidiocan, Wilayah Romblon menjadi Sekolah Rendah Damaso Ramilo Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6220_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Lumbang Elementary School in the Municipality of Cajidiocan, Province of Romblon, is hereby changed to Damaso Ramilo Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971. s
